result.stdout:
Usage: mkauth [options]

Compute HTTP Authorization headers (Basic, Bearer, OAuth 1.0a, JWT, Azure Storage SharedKey).

Options:
  --value-only                 Print the header value only — keeps the scheme prefix (e.g. 'Bearer <jwt>'); not a bare token
  --show-base-string           (oauth1/azure-storage) emit the computed signature base string for debugging
  --claims-stdin               (jwt) merge a JSON object from stdin (exclusive with --key stdin)
  --iat                        (jwt) set iat to now
  --user NAME                  (basic) username — required
  --password REF               (basic) password secret reference (env:/file:/vault:/literal:/stdin) — required
  --token REF                  (bearer) token secret reference; (oauth1) oauth_token value
  --method VERB                (oauth1/azure-storage) HTTP method — required
  --url URL                    (oauth1/azure-storage) full request URL — required
  --consumer-key K             (oauth1) oauth_consumer_key — required
  --consumer-secret REF        (oauth1) consumer secret reference — required
  --token-secret REF           (oauth1) token secret reference (empty for 2-legged)
  --signature-method M         (oauth1) HMAC-SHA1 (default), HMAC-SHA256, or PLAINTEXT
  --realm R                    (oauth1) realm (not part of the signature base)
  --timestamp N                (oauth1) override oauth_timestamp (default: clock)
  --nonce S                    (oauth1) override oauth_nonce (default: random)
  --alg A                      (jwt) HS256 (default), HS384, HS512, RS256/384/512, ES256/384/512
  --key REF                    (jwt) signing key reference; (azure-storage) account key reference — required
  --claims-file PATH           (jwt) JSON object merged into the claim set
  --iss S                      (jwt) iss claim
  --sub S                      (jwt) sub claim
  --aud S                      (jwt) aud claim
  --exp DURATION               (jwt) exp = now + DURATION
  --nbf DURATION               (jwt) nbf = now + DURATION
  --kid S            
[truncated]
